chunks: Those who are infidels will surely receive severe punishment both in this world and the next; and none will they have to help (or save) them.
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for disbelievers in this world and the hereafter?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual nature of divine retribution, where the 'severe punishment' in this world often refers to the humiliation and loss of status experienced by disbelievers during the lifetime of the Prophet and the Imams, while the Hereafter punishment is eternal. The absence of a 'nasir' (helper) underscores the concept of divine isolation for those who reject the truth, contrasting with the support granted to the faithful. This reinforces the Shia understanding of the continuity of divine justice across both temporal and spiritual realms.
